About Us
Eternal University is a NAAC Accredited & ISO 9001:2015 Certified
                                            University established under the Himachal Pradesh Private University Act
                                            2006. It operates under Himachal Pradesh Government Act no. 3 of 2009, with
                                            full rights to confer degrees as per UGC public notices on private
                                            universities. The great visionary of the 20th century, Sant Attar Singh Ji,
                                            foresaw that modern scientific education alone cannot fully serve humanity
                                            well. He envisioned that science must be deeply amalgamated with Braham
                                            Vidya (Spiritual Education) for complete holistic development. Consequently,
                                            our graduates excel academically while embodying stellar moral values as
                                            global Ambassadors of Peace.

Voices of Eternal University
Student Success
"
I had completed my B.Sc.(Hons.) in Physics and also pursuing M.Sc.(Physics) from Akal College of Basic Sciences, Eternal University, Baru Sahib. The five years at Eternal University changed my life in a better way. Eternal University is like my home which is far away from my real home. A place I always felt comfortable, safe and could always find a willing ear to listen and a little motivation from teachers was enough to keep up with everything at college. As a Student, the staff of the college gave me some key insights and resources to ensure my success. From the religious vibes of Darbar Sahib to the palatable food of Apple a day it was commendable. I had collected memories and good experiences from different co-curricular activities in my college days. The enthusiastic, disciplined, and learning environment always lifted me and was able to develop professionally as well as morally. Away from the city clamor, free from noise pollution, Baru Sahib is a divine valley of peace, indeed. !!
"
Ms. Anjna Sharma
2021 Passout
"I had completed my B.Sc. Agriculture from Dr. Khem Singh Gill Akal College of Agriculture Eternal University, Baru Sahib. Agriculture subject cannot be completed only by theoretical knowledge. Therefore, this university provides the practical knowledge and some additional skills along with subjective studies. It has peaceful and secure environment for students along with best hostel facilities. It has wonderful teachers, who had also guided and boosted us to face the competitive world with confidence.  This university believes not only on metal development, but also gave great emphasis on physical, social and emotional growth of each and every student. Eternal University would accommodate the distinctive needs of all genres of students by continually developing in academics and additional programs. This university helps me to understand the real meaning of professional studies and had prepared me in four years to share my scientific knowledge with society. Eternal university had provided us with certain skills and values that help us to shape ourselves into a divergent personalities and today I can confidently say that YES, I’m ready to enter into an Agriculture world."

"
I am currently pursuing my
Masters in TEXAS STATE UNIVERSTY, San Marcos, Texas, USA. "I am proud to
say that I completed my B.Sc. (Hons) Agriculture from Dr. Khem Singh Gill Akal
College of Agriculture, Eternal University, Baru Sahib (Batch 2020 - 24). The
university's serene and picturesque campus provided an ideal environment for
learning and growth. The faculty members were highly experienced and
supportive, guiding us through the intricacies of agricultural science. The
course curriculum was well-structured, covering a wide range of topics from
crop production and soil science to agricultural economics and entomology. The
university's emphasis on practical learning and hands-on experience helped me
develop skills that are essential for a successful career in agriculture.
The university's
location in the Himalayan foothills provided a unique opportunity to learn
about sustainable agriculture and organic farming practices. The exposure to
the local farming community and the university's own farms helped me understand
the challenges and opportunities in agricultural development. I am grateful to
Eternal University for providing me with a solid foundation in agricultural
Science
"

world-class education is reflected in its distinguished faculty,
state-of-the-art facilities, and dynamic learning environment.I would like to express

music have inspired me to think critically and creatively and pushing me to
explore new dimensions in my studies and research

Hello, everyone!  My name is Jaspreet Kaur and I am a Ph.D.
scholar in the Music Department at Akal College of Arts and Social Sciences,
Eternal University, Baru Sahib.  I’ve had
the privilege of being part of this institution for the past decade and I'm originally

education, finding an ideal environment for learning is rare. Eternal
University is unique in that regard, offering the perfect balance of high
academic standards and a peaceful, secure campus. The serene surroundings allow
students like me to truly focus on our studies, free from external
distractions.One of the most enriching aspects of my academic journey has been
the faculty in the Music
Department. They are
not just teachers but mentors who nurture and inspire us to realize our full
potential. Their unwavering support has played a key role in enhancing my
creative abilities and pushing me to achieve more in my field.I have also had
the privilege of being inspired by the legendary Sant Baba Iqbal Singh Ji, who
gave me a remarkable opportunity to pursue music. His vision for students was
clear: to elevate our skills to the highest level, especially in the field of
instrumental music, even encouraging us to pursue PhD in this domain.Moreover,
I had the honor of joining the International Anahadh Bani Jatha, Baru Sahib, an
experience that has deeply enriched my musical journey.
At my heart, Eternal University provides a
nurturing space where academic excellence, personal development, and creativity
intersect. The university's holistic approach, deeply rooted in Gurmat values,
which has not only shaped my academic pursuits but also helped me grow as a
researcher, writer, and musician. It has truly been an invaluable
part of my journey.
